MenuTopmostOn: Keep on top: On (click to disable)
MenuTopmostOff: Keep on top: Off (click to enable)
LblAccountName: Account name (optional, to tell accounts apart)
HistoryCollecting: Collecting usage history (one sample every ~5 min)…
TipSizeHint: Click for details, double-click for mini
NotifyHourlyBody1: The 5-hour window is {0}% burned — ease off 🔥
NotifyWeeklyBody1: Weekly quota is {0}% burned — budget the rest 📉
NotifyWeeklyBody2: Weekly quota near the threshold — pace the long jobs
NotifyWeeklyBody3: {0}% of the weekly quota is gone
NotifyBurnSuffix: At the current burn rate, ~{0} to empty
HiddenBody: Quota monitoring keeps running in the background. Click the tray icon to bring the card back; right-click it to quit.
SettingsDesc: GLM Coding Plan quota, desktop behavior, notifications and software updates
HotkeyHint: e.g. Ctrl+Alt+B (letter / digit / F1-F24, with at least one modifier)
HotkeyInvalid: Invalid hotkey format — previous setting kept
DiagnosticsHint: When something breaks, copy the diagnostics (version, account setup, failure log; no keys, no quota data) and paste them to the developer for a fast diagnosis.
DiagnosticsCopied: Copied to the clipboard — paste it to the developer.
DiagnosticsCopyFailed: Copy failed — please screenshot this page instead.
AccountDesc: Your key is used only to query Coding Plan quota from the selected GLM platform. BrainFuel prefers OS-protected secret storage instead of writing the key in plaintext settings.
CredentialProtected: Your API key is protected by {0}; settings.json no longer contains the plaintext key.
CredentialUnavailable: Your saved API key remains protected by {0}, but the system secret store is temporarily unavailable. BrainFuel will not downgrade it to plaintext and will retry on later quota refreshes.
CredentialFallback: OS secret storage is currently unavailable. The key is temporarily stored in settings.json with user-only file permissions. Enable the system keyring and save again when possible.
CredentialEmpty: When you save a key BrainFuel will prefer {0}; it falls back to a user-restricted local settings file only if the system secret store is unavailable.
CredentialPendingClear: Saving will remove BrainFuel's stored API key. Even if the system secret store is unavailable now, the old key will not be restored later.
NotificationsDesc: Show a local desktop notification when quota is nearly exhausted.
SoftwareDesc: Manage the BrainFuel application version here. This is separate from refreshing quota data.
SoftwareTrustDesc: Official builds come from GitHub Actions and Releases include SHA256SUMS plus Artifact Attestation. Windows commercial code signing is not purchased, so SmartScreen may still appear.
FirstRunBody: Paste your GLM Coding Plan key and save. The main card's “Refresh quota” action only refreshes quota data; Settings, software updates, display movement and About live in the top-right “⋯” app menu.
KeyHint: Your GLM Coding Plan key (same one the glm-plan-usage plugin uses)
ValidateBadKey: Key check failed (HTTP {0}) — verify the key and platform match
ValidateNetwork: Connection failed — check your network, or save now and it retries later
PaletteHint: Click to preview instantly; saved on Save. The amber/red urgency colors stay fixed.
ChkAlwaysOnTop: Keep the card above other windows
AlwaysOnTopHint: When enabled the card stays above other apps. Disable it to let active windows cover BrainFuel and reduce interruption while you work.
PlacementHint: BrainFuel remembers the display and relative card position. If an external display is unplugged, the card moves to the primary display and will not jump back when the display reconnects. Resolution, DPI and taskbar changes are also clamped to keep the full card visible.
KeyPlaceholder: Paste your GLM Coding Plan key
CliLoginHint: Codex/Claude accounts need no key: BrainFuel reads the local CLI login (~/.codex, ~/.claude) fresh on every refresh.
CliLoginMissing: No local {0} login detected — the account cannot be saved.
IntervalInputHint: Type 1–60, press Enter or click elsewhere, or use a preset.
IntervalPendingStatus: Pending: refresh quota every {0} minutes. Click “Save & apply” to activate it.
ChkNotify: Notify when quota is nearly exhausted
UpdateInstalledOnly: Portable builds do not self-update. Download the latest ZIP from Releases.
UpdatePortableHint: Portable builds update manually; the Windows installed build supports automatic delta updates.
UpdateFailed: Software update check failed. Please try again later.
FailureAuthentication: API key or platform doesn't match
FailureNoCodingPlan: No Coding Plan on this account
ValidationAuthentication: The API key is invalid or does not match the selected platform. Check the key and the Zhipu China / Z.ai international selection.
ValidationNetwork: BrainFuel cannot reach the GLM service. Check the network and retry, or save now and let BrainFuel refresh when connectivity returns.
ValidationTls: TLS / certificate negotiation failed. Check the system clock, certificate store, or whether a corporate network is intercepting HTTPS.
ValidationProxy: Proxy connection failed. Check the system, corporate proxy, or VPN configuration.
ValidationTimeout: The GLM request timed out. Check the network or proxy and try again later.
ValidationRateLimited: GLM rate-limited the request. Try again later; you can save the current settings now.
ValidationNoCodingPlan: No usable Coding Plan quota was found for this account. Confirm the key belongs to an account with GLM Coding Plan enabled; for recently purchased plans the monitor endpoint may not cover them yet — you can save and keep refreshing.
ValidationServiceUnavailable: The GLM service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later; you can save the current settings now.
ValidationInvalidResponse: GLM returned data BrainFuel does not recognize, possibly due to a temporary API change. You can save now and retry later.
ValidationUnknown: Quota validation failed. You can save the settings and try again later.
